long.vo: Two hundred and seventy-eight IPL matches, and five titles. We went through every ball धोनी faced since twenty thirteen, and his story is not really about runs. It's about the last two overs.

For fifteen overs, he was slower than the league. A strike rate of eighty in the powerplay, and ninety-three in the middle overs, against one twenty-eight for everyone else. In our archive, since twenty thirteen.

Then, from the sixteenth over, it flipped. One seventy-four, against one sixty for the league, across one thousand, four hundred and seventy-five balls. No one has faced more death-over balls. No one has scored more runs there: two thousand, five hundred and seventy-three.
And the last two overs were his. One thousand, two hundred and seventy runs, more than anyone, and ninety-eight sixes. The next best has fifty-nine.

scene.label: SIXES, MORE THAN ANYONE
scene.note: Next best: 59 (Hardik Pandya) · in our archive

long.vo: In the twentieth over itself, he scored at two fifty-two. The rest of the league managed one eighty-two.

He kept doing it for a decade. Two hundred and three in twenty thirteen, and two hundred and one in twenty eighteen. In twenty twenty-three, the title year, one eighty-six. In twenty twenty-four, two twenty-one. In twenty twenty-five, one fifty-two, below the league's one seventy-two.

head.t: DEATH-OVER STRIKE RATE, SEASON BY SEASON

long.vo: Our verdict? धोनी was not an accumulator. A slow build, then no one has scored more in the last two overs. The finisher was the whole career.
Is he the greatest finisher in IPL history? Tell us in the comments, and subscribe for more data stories.

long.description:
MS Dhoni's IPL in numbers: we went through every ball he faced in the IPL since 2013. For fifteen overs he was slower than the league (strike rate 80 in the powerplay, 93 in overs 7-15, against 128). Then from the 16th over: 174 against 160, across 1,475 balls and 2,573 runs, both more than anyone in our archive. In the last two overs, 1,270 runs and 98 sixes (next best: 59). In the 20th over, a strike rate of 252 against 182 for the league. A slow build, then no one scored more.

Career: 278 IPL matches, 5,439 runs, five titles as captain (2010, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023). CSK announced his retirement from the IPL as a player on 17 November 2026; he becomes team mentor.

Method: Sportmonks ball-by-ball, every IPL match 2013-2025 (2008-2012 are not in our data), super overs excluded; death overs = 16-20. All archive figures are 'in our archive'. Career totals: Eastern Eye, Khel Now, ETV Bharat, Cricketaddictor.
